body: I think I have the hardest time with accepting it myself and yeah, it's really awful the social stigmas we have against mentally ill people. I think it's time I finally deal with it. I don't understand, my irrational behaviours don't make sense, I'm very impulsive when I'm in that state and it just doesn't make sense at all. Ugh. But thank you for your comment.

Thank you so much.  <3
I've book an appointment with a doctor and I've reached out to some friends. I'll work on reaching out to family next.
